job.job_description:
AI Engineer (Generative AI / LLM Engineer)

Experience: 1-5+ Years




About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced AI Engineer (Generative AI / LLM Engineer) to architect, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions powered by Large Language Models (LLMs).

This role is focused on building intelligent AI systems that can reason, analyze data, interact with databases and APIs, automate business workflows, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The position goes far beyond chatbot development and requires hands-on expertise in production-scale AI implementations.

The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in designing, deploying, and maintaining real-world GenAI applications used by customers, enterprises, or internal business teams.

Key Responsibilities

AI Solution Development

Design, develop, and deploy advanced AI applications powered by Large Language Models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Llama, etc.).
Build intelligent AI agents capable of multi-step reasoning, decision-making, and workflow automation.
Develop scalable AI architectures for enterprise use cases.

Agentic AI & Workflow Automation

Build and manage agentic workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar frameworks.
Develop autonomous AI systems capable of interacting with APIs, databases, documents, and business applications.
Implement tool-calling, function-calling, and multi-agent orchestration.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Design and implement enterprise-grade RAG pipelines.
Build document ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, and ranking mechanisms.
Optimize retrieval accuracy and response quality for large-scale knowledge bases.

Integration & Automation

Integrate AI systems with REST APIs, databases, CRMs, ERPs, and third-party applications.
Develop intelligent automation workflows for business operations.
Build secure and scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI.

Structured Outputs & AI Reliability

Implement structured outputs using Pydantic and schema-based validation.
Ensure reliable AI-generated responses for downstream systems.
Design guardrails, validation layers, and safety mechanisms.

Performance Monitoring & Optimization

Monitor model performance, token consumption, latency, and operational costs.
Implement AI observability and evaluation frameworks.
Continuously improve model quality, reliability, and business performance.

Mandatory Technical Skills

Programming & Backend Development

Strong expertise in Python.
Hands-on experience with:
FastAPI
Async Programming
Pydantic
REST APIs
Microservices Architecture

Generative AI & LLMs

Extensive experience with:
OpenAI GPT Models
Anthropic Claude
Gemini
Open-source LLMs
Strong understanding of:
Prompt Engineering
Function Calling
Tool Calling
AI Agent Architectures
Context Management
Token Optimization

RAG & Knowledge Systems

RAG Architecture Design
Embeddings and Semantic Search
Document Processing Pipelines
Knowledge Base Construction
Hybrid Search Techniques

Vector Databases

Pinecone
Weaviate
pgvector
ChromaDB
Similar vector search platforms

AI Evaluation & Observability

LLM Evaluation Frameworks
Prompt Testing
AI Monitoring
Hallucination Detection
Quality Benchmarking
Cost Monitoring



Mandatory Real-World Project Experience (Non-Negotiable)

Candidates must have hands-on experience delivering production-grade Generative AI solutions in real business environments.

The candidate should have successfully worked on:

Enterprise AI applications deployed to production.
Agentic AI systems serving business users or customers.
Large-scale RAG implementations with enterprise data.
AI-powered workflow automation solutions.
API-integrated LLM applications.
AI systems connected with databases and business applications.
Production deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and optimization of AI solutions.

Candidates Must Be Able To Demonstrate:

Real-world GenAI projects currently or previously in production.
Architecture diagrams and implementation approach.
Individual contribution to the project.
Business impact generated by the solution.
Challenges faced and solutions implemented.
Scalability, performance, and reliability considerations.

Profiles That Will NOT Be Considered:

Certification-only candidates.
Candidates with only academic projects.
Proof-of-concept (PoC) experience without production deployment.
Candidates lacking hands-on implementation experience.
Candidates unable to explain architecture and project ownership.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building multi-agent AI systems.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Knowledge of containerization and deployment using Docker/Kubernetes.
Exposure to MLOps and AIOps practices.
Experience with enterprise security and governance frameworks.
Understanding of AI compliance and responsible AI principles.



What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently designing and delivering complete AI solutions from concept to production. We are looking for someone who has moved beyond experimentation and has successfully built AI systems that solve real business problems at scale.
